We have two subnetworks: task_0_subnet_1 has resistors R1=10, R2=20 both between A and X1 (parallel? Actually connections list shows both from A to X1). So they are parallel between A and X1.

task_0_subnet_2 has R1=20, R2=15, R3=10, R4=5 forming series from B to X1 via nodes N_b3,N_b2,N_b1. So series chain.

We need combine all subnetworks to form complete network. The combined network should have total 6 resistors (as notes). So we need rename resistors to avoid duplicate IDs. In combined topology we have 6 resistors: the two from subnet1 (R1,R2) and four from subnet2 (R1,R2,R3,R4). Need unique IDs, maybe R1,R2,R3,R4,R5,R6.

We already simulated a topology with R1=10,R2=20 (parallel A-X1) and R3=20,R4=15,R5=10,R6=5 series B->N_b3->N_b2->N_b1->X1. That gave correct measured resistances: A-B 56.667 matches measurement, A-X1 6.667 matches measurement. Need also other measurements? Could test a few.

Let's test A-N_b1 measurement 11.667 expected. Simulate A to N_b1.
